title: lichen/subsys/lichen/link/Kconfig: BACKOFF_MIN/MAX ranges allow inverted configuration
description:
LICHEN_TDMA_CONTENTION_BACKOFF_MIN_MS (range 10-5000) and LICHEN_TDMA_CONTENTION_BACKOFF_MAX_MS (range 10-10000) overlap completely. A user can configure MIN=5000 and MAX=10, making min > max. The help text states 'pick uniform random in [min_ms, max_ms)' - when min > max, this causes undefined behavior (negative modulo, assertion failure, or wraparound to huge delay).

Fix suggestion: Kconfig cannot express cross-symbol constraints, so the consuming C code must validate min < max and fail clearly. Alternatively, narrow MIN range to 10-4999 and MAX to 5000-10000 to prevent overlap (but this is restrictive).
